#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
ll rep[20];
int best;

pair<int,int> get_leading(ll x) {
    int len = 0;
    while(x >= 10) {
        x /= 10;
        ++len;
    }
    return {x, len};
}

void dfs(ll x, int cost) {
    if(cost >= best) return;
    if(x == 0) {
        best = cost;
        return;
    }
    auto [t, len] = get_leading(x);
    dfs(abs(x - rep[len] * t), cost + t * (len + 1));
    if(t - 1 > 0) dfs(abs(x - rep[len] * (t - 1)), cost + (t - 1) * (len + 1));
    if(t > 1) dfs(abs(rep[len + 1] - x), cost + (len + 2));
}

int main() {
    ll n;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    rep[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i <= 18; ++i) rep[i] = rep[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    best = 1e9;
    dfs(n, 0);
    printf("%d\n", best);
    return 0;
}
